Sound of India. Something that signifies that which is rooted in tradition and ever modern. Maestro Niladri Kumar was called upon to create an Inspirational theme that signifies the power of Indian Music. The India Energy Official Theme Music for G20 Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas.
Niladri Kumar - Sitar Zitar & Composition
Arjun Nair - Track Production and Vocals
Sridar Parthasarathy - Mridangam
Video - Samira Kelkar
